metadata.name: claude__code_report
metadata.comment: Claude Code activity, one row per actor, day, terminal type and customer type. An actor is either a person, identified by email, or an API key, identified by name. Per-model token and cost detail is reported for only about 1% of rows, so it is rolled up onto the parent instead of fanned out into per-model rows.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

claude_code_usage_report_id.name: claude_code_usage_report_id
claude_code_usage_report_id.comment: Fivetran-generated unique identifier for the usage report row.

report_date.name: report_date
report_date.comment: Date the Claude Code activity occurred.

organization_id.name: organization_id
organization_id.comment: Identifier of the organization. Joins to `stg_claude__organization.organization_id`.

customer_type.name: customer_type
customer_type.comment: Type of customer account ("api" for API customers, "subscription" for Pro/Team customers).

actor_email_address.name: actor_email_address
actor_email_address.comment: Email address of the actor. Populated only when `actor_type` is "user_actor".

actor_api_key_name.name: actor_api_key_name
actor_api_key_name.comment: Name of the API key. Populated only when `actor_type` is "api_actor".

user_id.name: user_id
user_id.comment: Identifier of the matching workspace user, resolved by email. Null for API key actors and for people with no workspace user record.

user_name.name: user_name
user_name.comment: Full name of the matching workspace user, if one was found.

user_role.name: user_role
user_role.comment: Organization role of the matching workspace user ("admin", "billing", "claude_code_user", "developer", "managed", "membership_admin", "owner", "primary_owner", "user"). Null for API key actors and for people with no workspace user record.

is_user_deleted.name: is_user_deleted
is_user_deleted.comment: Whether the matching workspace user is deleted or no longer a member.

terminal_type.name: terminal_type
terminal_type.comment: Terminal or environment Claude Code ran in.

count_sessions.name: count_sessions
count_sessions.comment: Distinct Claude Code sessions initiated by this actor.

count_commits.name: count_commits
count_commits.comment: Git commits created through Claude Code.

count_pull_requests.name: count_pull_requests
count_pull_requests.comment: Pull requests created through Claude Code.

count_lines_of_code_added.name: count_lines_of_code_added
count_lines_of_code_added.comment: Lines of code added across all files by Claude Code.

count_lines_of_code_removed.name: count_lines_of_code_removed

count_model_families_used.name: count_model_families_used

count_model_variants_used.name: count_model_variants_used

metadata.name: claude__enterprise_cost_usage_report
metadata.comment: Enterprise per-user cost joined to per-user token usage. One row per actor, day, product, model, cost type and token type. Speed, context window and inference geo are summed away so both sides share a grain. The Analytics API reports per-user cost directly, so cost drives the grain and usage attaches to it; usage with no matching cost row is still carried. Aligned with `int_anthropic_enterprise_cost_usage` in the internal analytics project.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day the cost and usage apply to.

organization_id.name: organization_id
organization_id.comment: Identifier of the organization. Joins to `stg_claude__organization.organization_id`.

actor_user_id.name: actor_user_id
actor_user_id.comment: Identifier of the enterprise actor. Joins to `stg_claude__enterprise_user_actor.actor_user_id`.

actor_email.name: actor_email
actor_email.comment: Email address of the actor, lowercased.

actor_name.name: actor_name
actor_name.comment: Full name of the actor, if provided.

is_actor_deleted.name: is_actor_deleted
is_actor_deleted.comment: Whether the actor is deleted or no longer a member of the organization.

product.name: product
product.comment: Anthropic product surface the cost and usage came from ("chat", "claude_code", "cowork", "office_agent", "claude_in_chrome", "claude_design", "claude-tag", "other").

model.name: model
model.comment: Claude model the cost and usage apply to.

model_family.name: model_family
model_family.comment: The model's family, parsed from `model` ("opus", "sonnet", "fable", "haiku"). 'unclassified' when the model name does not match a known Claude family.

model_variant.name: model_variant
model_variant.comment: The model's version, parsed from `model` (e.g. "4.5", "4.6", "5"). Null when the model name does not match a known Claude version pattern.

cost_type.name: cost_type
cost_type.comment: Category of cost ("code_execution", "tokens", "web_search"). Null on rows carrying usage that has no matching cost.

token_unit_type.name: token_unit_type
token_unit_type.comment: Token type the cost and usage apply to ("input", "cache_read", "cache_creation_5m", "cache_creation_1h", "output"). Null for cost that is not token based.

unit_quantity.name: unit_quantity
unit_quantity.comment: Tokens of this unit type the actor consumed that day. Null for cost that is not token based.

request.name: request
request.comment: Total API requests the actor made for this product and model on this day. Only populated on rows where `token_unit_type = 'input'`; null on all other token type rows to avoid double-counting across the unpivoted grain.

server_tool_use_web_search_request.name: server_tool_use_web_search_request
server_tool_use_web_search_request.comment: Total web search tool calls made by the actor for this product and model on this day. Only populated on rows where `token_unit_type = 'input'`; null on all other token type rows to avoid double-counting across the unpivoted grain.

claude_cost.name: claude_cost
claude_cost.comment: Cost after discounts and before credits, in fractional cents (minor units), matching the unit `stg_claude__enterprise_user_cost_report.amount` is reported in. Null on rows carrying usage that has no matching cost.

claude_list_cost.name: claude_list_cost
claude_list_cost.comment: List-price cost before discounts, in fractional cents (minor units).

claude_discount.name: claude_discount
claude_discount.comment: Difference between list cost and actual cost.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: Currency code for the cost amounts. Currently always "USD".

data_refreshed_at.name: data_refreshed_at
data_refreshed_at.comment: Timestamp of the export the cost was served from. Data is typically refreshed every 4 hours but is not final until about 30 days after the usage date.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: claude__platform_cost_usage_report
metadata.comment: Organization cost joined to API message usage, with cost allocated down to the API key that consumed it. One row per API key, day, model, cost type and token type. Service tier, context window and inference geo are summed away because the cost report breaks cost out by inference geo, which message usage never reports. Cost that cannot be attributed to an API key is still carried, so `claude_cost` sums to the total in `stg_claude__cost_report`. Aligned with `int_anthropic_platform_cost_usage` in the internal analytics project.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

date_day.name: date_day
date_day.comment: Day the cost and usage apply to.

workspace_id.name: workspace_id
workspace_id.comment: ID of the Workspace the cost and usage belong to. Message usage does not always report a workspace, so this falls back to the workspace recorded on the API key. Null for organization-level cost that names no workspace.

workspace_name.name: workspace_name
workspace_name.comment: Name of the workspace. Null on rows not attributed to an API key.

api_key_id.name: api_key_id
api_key_id.comment: Identifier of the API key the cost was allocated to. Null when the cost could not be attributed to an API key (see `allocation_method`).

api_key_name.name: api_key_name
api_key_name.comment: Name of the API key. Null on rows not attributed to an API key.

is_api_key_deleted.name: is_api_key_deleted
is_api_key_deleted.comment: Whether the API key is deleted or no longer active. Null on rows not attributed to an API key.

is_creator_deleted.name: is_creator_deleted
is_creator_deleted.comment: Whether the user who created the API key is deleted or no longer a member of the organization. Null on rows not attributed to an API key, and when the API key's creator is not a user.

model.name: model
model.comment: Claude model the cost and usage apply to.

model_family.name: model_family
model_family.comment: The model's family, parsed from `model` ("opus", "sonnet", "fable", "haiku"). 'unclassified' when the model name does not match a known Claude family.

model_variant.name: model_variant
model_variant.comment: The model's version, parsed from `model` (e.g. "4.5", "4.6", "5"). Null when the model name does not match a known Claude version pattern.

token_unit_type.name: token_unit_type
token_unit_type.comment: Token type the cost and usage apply to ("input", "cache_read", "cache_creation_5m", "cache_creation_1h", "output"). Null for cost that is not token based.

unit_quantity.name: unit_quantity
unit_quantity.comment: Tokens of this unit type consumed by this API key that day. Null for cost that is not token based, and on rows not attributed to an API key.

token_share.name: token_share
token_share.comment: The API key's share of the workspace tokens the cost was spread across. For token cost this is its share of tokens of the same unit type; for non-token cost it is its share of every token the workspace used that day. Sums to 1 within each group.

claude_cost.name: claude_cost
claude_cost.comment: Cost attributed to this row, in fractional cents (minor units), matching the unit `stg_claude__cost_report.amount` is reported in. Equals the workspace cost for the slice multiplied by `token_share`, except on unallocated rows where it is the remainder that no API key could be attributed.

currency.name: currency
currency.comment: Currency code for the cost amount. Currently always "USD".

allocation_method.name: allocation_method
allocation_method.comment: How `claude_cost` was derived. "token_share" means it was allocated by the API key's share of workspace tokens of the same unit type. "web_search_request_share" means it was allocated by the API key's share of web search requests, which is exact because web search bills at a flat rate per request. "unallocated" means no API key could be matched, so the cost is carried at workspace grain -- this covers session usage and code execution cost, which names no model or token type to allocate on.

has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table
